episodes.title: Oneida: How a Free-Love Cult Swapped Eugenics for Silverware
episodes.description:
Ever looked at your kitchen silverware drawer and wondered where it actually came from? Welcome back to the Cabinet of Curiosities! Today, we are opening the file on Oneida—the famous flatware company that actually started as a 19th-century "Bible Communist" eugenics cult.

Let me know in the comments: Did you check your fork drawer after watching this video? 

Stay weird, and tell your dog I said HI!
